xsheet.note: the geese sit on the bank with wings folded low and flat
the first geese on the left and centre open their wings over a few frames and lift off
more groups lift a few at a time while a band of geese still rests near the water
the last resting geese near the water open their wings and lift
the final group leaves the bank
the flock loosens: the gaps between birds widen frame by frame
the lower birds now fly across the tops of the bare trees while others stay high

camera_source: Lucas-Kanade on corner features outside the dilated SAM mask (trees, reeds, water), median step per frame; frames with no usable features take the neighbours' step; a 3-frame mean removes the long-short step alternation of the footage; scaled by 1.62/2 so that the tree plane (z 1.62 from depth) slides by the measured amount. shots/animal-migration-sam/camera.json was not used because it holds still from frame 19 to 42 while the footage pans.
